text_block_list.text:
It's the morning of the Japanese
Derby—held at
Tokyo Racecourse, it
boasts a straight that's
525.9 meters
long.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The wind's blowing in a good direction...
There's
nothing to stand in my way...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан and Ines Fujin stand on
opposite
sides of the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's so long... There's no way I can sprint
that
whole distance...
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Or maybe I can? I've done all I can in
preparation
for this once-in-a-life
chance, but was it enough?
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
Well... There's no way to really know
until I go for
it! Okay...
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I'm set! And I know Ryan will be right
there with
me!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin

text_block_list.text:
I'm not good enough... 525 meters is just
too
much...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ines is sure to win this as long as I don't
have what
it takes to keep up.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But even if it's impossible, even if I can't
make it...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: I need to regain all my lost confidence!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
If I really do have what it takes, then I'll
definitely
keep up with her!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I stand beside Ryan as she stares at
Ines's
silhouette in the distance. Their
Derby is about to
begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I swear I'll take the lead!
text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
